name: Your Company
tagline: Garden and terrace furniture for the dacha, courtyard and aivan

seo.title: Your Company — garden furniture for dacha and terrace
seo.description: Garden furniture in teak, acacia and rattan: dining sets, loungers, swings and suri for the aivan. Showroom in Kibray, delivery across the region and winter storage.
seo.answer: Your Company is a garden furniture showroom in Kibray (14 Tashkent Ring Road). Acacia dining sets from UZS 7,200,000, teak loungers from UZS 2,900,000, suri for the aivan from UZS 5,500,000. Delivery across Tashkent region, on-site assembly and winter storage.

listing.description: A site for a garden furniture, gazebo or dacha goods shop: a calm natural first screen, sets presented like hotel rooms, benefits, steps and questions.

sections.title: An evening in the courtyard starts with a good chair
sections.eyebrow: Showroom in Kibray · 15 minutes from Tashkent
sections.subtitle: Teak, acacia and rattan that stand up to sun, rain and the Uzbek summer. We deliver, assemble and take it away for storage in winter.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: Furniture that isn’t afraid of the outdoors
sections.text:
For eight years we have made and sourced furniture for dachas, courtyards and restaurant terraces. Wood gets two coats of oil, metal is powder-coated, and the outdoor fabrics don’t fade and dry within an hour.
Before buying you can sit on everything in our open-air showroom.

items.q: Can the furniture stay out in the rain?
items.a: Yes, the wood is oiled and the fabrics are outdoor grade. It is best to bring cushions in at night.

items.q: How do I care for teak?
items.a: Wipe with the oil from the kit once a season. Without oil teak turns grey, which is normal and doesn’t affect its strength.
